proposals.evidence: DEDR 3640 explicitly gives Kui nāṇi/nāṛi ‘fire’, beside Pengo nāṇi and Kuvi nāṇi. The survey nāni matches the Kui fire noun, with its source nasal notation preserved.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 990 explicitly groups the one numeral: (a) Tamil oru, Kannada obba, Kui ro, Kurux ort and Brahui asiṭ; (b) Telugu okaṭi, Kolami okkod and Gadaba ukuṭ; (c) Kurux oṇṭā; (d) Tamil oṉṟu/oṇṇu, Kannada ondu, Tulu oñji, Gondi undi and Kurux ōnd. The selected simple survey responses fit the corresponding branch; composite and divergent responses remain unassigned. User clarified on 2026-09-21 that each DEDR node represents the whole dictionary article, not only the displayed reconstruction. The head label remains unchanged; the cited article family/subsection is the proposed parent scope. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
